extensionName.description: Extension name shown in add-on manager

extensionDescription.message: Displays the chronological email thread as metadata and snippets in the message panel.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in add-on manager

panelTitle.description: Title of the thread panel showing message count

modeCurrentTab.description: Navigation mode indicator: open in current tab

modeNewTab.description: Navigation mode indicator: open in new tab

tooltipCurrentTab.message: Click switches the message in the active tab

tooltipNewTab.message: Click opens the message in a new tab

tooltipToggleMode.description: Tooltip for the toggle navigation mode button

tooltipAttachment.description: Tooltip for the attachment paperclip icon

unknownAuthor.description: Fallback author name when author is unknown

optNavGroupTitle.message: Behavior when clicking a message in the thread:
optNavGroupTitle.description: Options group title for navigation behavior

optNavCurrentTabLabel.description: Label for current tab navigation option

optNavCurrentTabDesc.message: Displays the selected message in the main panel. The application automatically switches folders if necessary. This is the most natural behavior to avoid tab accumulation.
optNavCurrentTabDesc.description: Description for current tab navigation option

optNavNewTabLabel.message: Open in a new native tab
optNavNewTabLabel.description: Label for new tab navigation option

optNavNewTabDesc.message: Opens the targeted message in a new Thunderbird message tab. This preserves your position and current folder in the main working tab.
optNavNewTabDesc.description: Description for new tab navigation option

optSidebarGroupTitle.description: Options group title for sidebar position in message tabs

optSidebarRightDesc.message: The thread is displayed in a side panel to the right of the message. The message content stays in its usual position.

optSidebarLeftDesc.message: The thread is displayed in a side panel to the left of the message.

optMainViewGroupTitle.description: Options group title for main view position

optMainViewBottom.description: Label for bottom position in main view

optMainViewBottomDesc.message: The thread is displayed below the message with a vertical resize handle.

optMainViewRight.message: Panel to the right of the message
optMainViewRight.description: Label for right sidebar in main view

optMainViewRightDesc.message: The thread is displayed in a side panel to the right of the message, with a horizontal resize handle.
optMainViewRightDesc.description: Description for right sidebar in main view

optStatusSaved.description: Status message shown after saving preferences

optThreadOrderTitle.description: Options group title for sorting order of the thread messages

optThreadOrderDesc.message: Determines whether the most recent messages are displayed at the top or bottom of the thread.
